title: Failure analysis
subtitle: Real golden-set misses and measured fixes — not hypotheticals.

cases.title: Dense-only retrieval collapses
cases.question: (System-level) Pure dense similarity over structural chunks with the local hashing embedder used in early retrieval experiments.
retrieved: Near-random neighbors — almost no expected source docs in top-5
cases.observed_behavior: Dense mode Recall@5 ≈ 3.9% on the answerable golden slice — effectively unusable alone.
cases.expected_behavior: Retrieve the docs that actually answer keyword and factual questions (IDs, status codes, quotas).

fix.summary: Added sparse BM25 + RRF hybrid, then feature rerank as production path.

cases.lesson: Vector search alone misses exact tokens. Hybrid is not optional on this corpus.

cases.title: Semantic chunking loses section boundaries
cases.question: (System-level) Same BM25 retriever across fixed / structural / semantic chunk stores.
retrieved: Semantically split chunks that drift from doc headings and quota tables
cases.observed_behavior: Semantic strategy Recall 80.2% vs structural 90.9% on the same sparse evaluator.
cases.expected_behavior: Chunks that preserve headings/tables so quotas and API names stay intact.

fix.summary: Production default set to structural chunking; semantic kept as experiment only.

cases.lesson: Smarter-looking chunkers can still lose the structure evaluators care about.

cases.title: Correct doc buried under noise (Lambda timeout)
cases.question: What is the maximum execution timeout for an AWS Lambda function?
cases.observed_behavior: Expected source is present (recall 1.0) but context precision is only 0.2 — four of five hits are unrelated. Answer stayed faithful because the right chunk was still in the set.
cases.expected_behavior: Top ranks dominated by aws-lambda-limits; fewer off-topic neighbors in the prompt.

fix.summary: hybrid_rerank is production default (precision@5 41.6% vs dense 0.9%). Further top-k / score-threshold tuning still open.

cases.lesson: Recall can look fine while the prompt is still polluted — measure precision too.

cases.title: Ambiguous question answered instead of clarifying
cases.question: What is the timeout?
cases.observed_behavior: Golden expects AMBIGUOUS / clarify which service. Pipeline did not refuse (refused=false) and retrieved mixed docs with precision 0.2.
cases.expected_behavior: Ask which timeout (Lambda vs HTTP vs other) or refuse as underspecified.

fix.summary: Unanswerable category already at 100% refusal accuracy. Ambiguous underspecified queries still need stronger clarify/refuse routing (Phase 14+).

metric_impact.note: No invented ambiguous-refusal lift — this case documents a remaining gap.

cases.lesson: Refusal on out-of-corpus is solved; refusal on underspecified-in-corpus is not.

cases.title: Ambiguous query with zero relevant retrieval
cases.question: Which model should I pick?
cases.observed_behavior: Context recall 0.0 and precision 0.0 — none of the Bedrock model docs retrieved. System still answered (refused=false) instead of clarifying embedding vs generation.
cases.expected_behavior: Clarify task (embed vs generate) or refuse; if answering, retrieve Titan/Claude docs.

fix.summary: Low retrieval score should trigger insufficient-evidence refusal more aggressively for ambiguous intents.

metric_impact.note: Tracked as an open failure — not marked fixed.

cases.lesson: When recall is zero, generating anyway is the failure — refusal should fire.
